name: deployment-team
description: Senior DevOps engineer team to deploy Node.js service to Ubuntu server with step-by-step checklist, environment preparation, code upload, service configuration, and startup verification.

tasks.subject: Research Ubuntu server environment and Node.js requirements
tasks.description: Gather information about typical Ubuntu server environments for Node.js deployment, including common packages, configuration files, service management (systemd), and best practices for security and performance.
tasks.output:
## Ubuntu Server Environment Research for Node.js Deployment

### 1. System Preparation
- OS: Ubuntu 20.04/22.04 LTS recommended
- Update system: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
- Install essential packages: sudo apt install -y curl wget git build-essential

### 2. Node.js Installation
- Recommended: NodeSource repository for latest LTS
  - curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash -
  - sudo apt install -y nodejs
- Verification: node --version && npm --version

### 3. User and Permissions
- Create dedicated user: sudo adduser deploy
- Set proper directory permissions

### 4. Systemd Service Management
- Service files location: /etc/systemd/system/
- Key directives: ExecStart, WorkingDirectory, User, Restart
- Commands: systemctl daemon-reload, enable/start/stop/restart

### 5. Security Best Practices
- Environment variables for secrets
- Firewall: sudo ufw allow 22,80,443/tcp && sudo ufw enable
- HTTPS with Let's Encrypt

### 6. Backup Strategy
- Backup configs: sudo cp /etc/systemd/system/<service>.service /etc/systemd/system/<service>.service.bak
- Database backups if applicable

### 7. Common Deployment Paths
- Application: /var/www/<app-name> or /opt/<app-name>
- Logs: /var/log/<app-name>

Include verification commands after each step.

tasks.description: Review the deployment checklist for: 1) Command correctness, 2) Proper error handling, 3) Backup procedures before configuration changes, 4) Security best practices, 5) Clear verification steps, 6) Comprehensive rollback plan.
